note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the document (generic lines and blocks), its reference, the supplied region, exhibits and order are as supplied and carry no legal assessment (no authenticity, admissibility, weight or ruling).

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Exploded plan with the default pieces: the page comes from the exhibit (relation) and is shown to the participants (communication); once the tracer reaches the board the document settles on it with its reference, its region is framed and enlarged into the zone; both places get the same neutral frame.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: four participants and another presenter, the places in the other order, two exhibits and the document from the second one; another order of the relationships, other captions, a traversal from the participants and the exhibit cabinet as focus.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Near-maximum lengths: four participants with long labels, a long reference and caption, two exhibits, a twelve-line page, long element labels and relationship captions.
presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (AUTHORING item 20). TRUE DRIVER: at 1:1 the exploded plan is narrow; the presenter stands right beside the board and the exhibit cabinet is lifted right above it, so the board's and the presenter's labels compete for the same strip of floor (each must stand nearer its own element than any other), and the near-maximum labels (45 and 46 characters) wrap to three lines. Tried before capping: every column (0.28–0.40) and band (2–3 columns) arrangement, band shares 0.24–0.42, room scales 1–1.4 on both sides, the 45 px stress floor, the label allowed above the wall. Rendered BEFORE (production/scratch/hearings-06/capmeasure.mjs, hold, 1080p): 16:9 18.9 px / people 61.3 px; 9:16 19.8 / 95.7; 1:1 16.4 / 52.0 with label-board. AFTER the cap (board label of 36 characters, presenter label of 35; every other field unchanged): 16:9 18.9 / 61.3; 9:16 19.8 / 95.7; 1:1 16.4 / 52.4 (>= 45 px stress floor); no problems. Both capped labels stay longer than their baselines (28 and 24 characters). Pre-cap preset: production/scratch/hearings-06/LAW-0302.presets.precap.json.
